	"context"

	"encoding/hex"

	"github.com/google/uuid"

	cliproxyauth "github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/v8/sdk/cliproxy/auth"
	cliproxyexecutor "github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/v8/sdk/cliproxy/executor"

	"google.golang.org/protobuf/encoding/protowire"
)

type oImage struct {
	Base64Data string `json:"base64_data"`
	MimeType   string `json:"mime_type"`
}
type oToolCall struct {
	ID        string `json:"id"`
	Name      string `json:"name"`
	Arguments string `json:"arguments"`
}
type oPrompt struct {
	MessageID     string      `json:"message_id"`
	Source        int         `json:"source"`
	Content       string      `json:"content"`
	Images        []oImage    `json:"images"`
	ToolCalls     []oToolCall `json:"tool_calls"`
	ToolCallID    string      `json:"tool_call_id"`
	OrigToolCall  string      `json:"original_tool_call_id"`
	IsOrphaned    bool        `json:"is_orphaned_tool"`
	Thinking      string      `json:"thinking"`
	SignatureB64  string      `json:"signature_b64"`
	SignatureType string      `json:"signature_type"`
}
type oTool struct {
	Name        string `json:"name"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
	Parameters  string `json:"parameters"`
}
type oWire struct {
	Name         string    `json:"name"`
	SessionToken string    `json:"session_token"`
	DeviceSeed   string    `json:"device_seed"`
	ModelUID     string    `json:"chat_model_uid"`
	System       string    `json:"system_prompt"`
	Prompts      []oPrompt `json:"prompts"`
	Tools        []oTool   `json:"tools"`
	Temperature  *float64  `json:"temperature"`
	MaxTokens    int       `json:"max_tokens"`
	SessionID    string    `json:"session_id"`
	CascadeID    string    `json:"cascade_id"`
	Words        []string  `json:"sensitive_words"`
	Repeat       int       `json:"repeat"`
	Hex          []string  `json:"hex"`
}
type oSanitize struct {
	Prompt string   `json:"prompt"`
	Words  []string `json:"words"`
	Out    string   `json:"out"`
}
type oTrailer struct {
	Payload string `json:"payload"`
	Status  int    `json:"status"`
	Err     string `json:"err"`
}
type oModel struct {
	Model  string `json:"model"`
	Level  string `json:"level"`
	Budget int    `json:"budget"`
	Out    string `json:"out"`
}
type oParse struct {
	Name     string          `json:"name"`
	Payload  string          `json:"payload"`
	Original string          `json:"original"`
	Out      json.RawMessage `json:"out"`
}
type oSig struct {
	In     string `json:"in"`
	BytesB string `json:"bytes_b64"`
	Type   string `json:"type"`
	Detect string `json:"detect"`
}
type oUUID struct {
	In  string `json:"in"`
	Out string `json:"out"`
}
type oFrame struct {
	Flag    int    `json:"flag"`
	Hex     string `json:"hex"`
	RawTail string `json:"raw_tail,omitempty"`
}
type oFormatOut struct {
	Format string   `json:"format"`
	Chunks []string `json:"chunks"`
	NonStr string   `json:"non_stream"`
}
type oStream struct {
	Name         string            `json:"name"`
	Frames       []oFrame          `json:"frames"`
	Requests     map[string]string `json:"requests"`
	Interactions string            `json:"interactions"`
	ConsumeErr   string            `json:"consume_err"`
	ConsumeCode  int               `json:"consume_code"`
	Formats      []oFormatOut      `json:"formats"`
}
type oE2E struct {
	Name         string `json:"name"`
	SourceFormat string `json:"source_format"`
	Model        string `json:"model"`
	Payload      string `json:"payload"`
	Hex          string `json:"hex"`
	URL          string `json:"url"`
	Err          string `json:"err"`
}
type oCases struct {
	E2E      []oE2E      `json:"e2e"`
	Wire     []oWire     `json:"wire"`
	Sanitize []oSanitize `json:"sanitize"`
	Trailers []oTrailer  `json:"trailers"`
	Models   []oModel    `json:"models"`
	Parse    []oParse    `json:"parse"`
	Sigs     []oSig      `json:"sigs"`
	UUIDs    []oUUID     `json:"uuids"`
	Streams  []oStream   `json:"streams"`
}

func toPrompts(in []oPrompt) []helps.DevinPrompt {
	var out []helps.DevinPrompt
	for _, p := range in {
		dp := helps.DevinPrompt{MessageID: p.MessageID, Source: p.Source, Content: p.Content, ToolCallID: p.ToolCallID, OriginalToolCallID: p.OrigToolCall, IsOrphanedTool: p.IsOrphaned, Thinking: p.Thinking, SignatureType: p.SignatureType}
		for _, i := range p.Images {
			dp.Images = append(dp.Images, helps.DevinImage{Base64Data: i.Base64Data, MimeType: i.MimeType})
		}
		for _, t := range p.ToolCalls {
			dp.ToolCalls = append(dp.ToolCalls, helps.DevinToolCall{ID: t.ID, Name: t.Name, Arguments: t.Arguments})
		}
		if p.SignatureB64 != "" {
			b, _ := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(p.SignatureB64)
			dp.Signature = b
		}
		out = append(out, dp)
	}
	return out
}

func fromPrompts(in []helps.DevinPrompt) []oPrompt {
	out := []oPrompt{}
	for _, p := range in {
		op := oPrompt{MessageID: "", Source: p.Source, Content: p.Content, ToolCallID: p.ToolCallID, OrigToolCall: p.OriginalToolCallID, IsOrphaned: p.IsOrphanedTool, Thinking: p.Thinking, SignatureType: p.SignatureType, Images: []oImage{}, ToolCalls: []oToolCall{}}
		for _, i := range p.Images {
			op.Images = append(op.Images, oImage{i.Base64Data, i.MimeType})
		}
		for _, t := range p.ToolCalls {
			op.ToolCalls = append(op.ToolCalls, oToolCall{t.ID, t.Name, t.Arguments})
		}
		if len(p.Signature) > 0 {
			op.SignatureB64 = base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(p.Signature)
		}
		out = append(out, op)
	}
	return out
}

type parseOut struct {
	System    string    `json:"system_prompt"`
	Prompts   []oPrompt `json:"prompts"`
	Tools     []oTool   `json:"tools"`
	Temp      *float64  `json:"temperature"`
	MaxTokens int       `json:"max_tokens"`
	Session   string    `json:"session_id"`
	Cascade   string    `json:"cascade_id"`
	Level     string    `json:"thinking_level"`
	Budget    int       `json:"budget_tokens"`
}

// maskProto drops per-request random values: prompt message ids (3.1), the session id inside
// field 15 (15.1) and the cascade id (field 16).
func maskProto(b []byte) []byte {
	var out []byte
	for len(b) > 0 {
		num, typ, n := protowire.ConsumeTag(b)
		if n < 0 {
			return out
		}
		vn := protowire.ConsumeFieldValue(num, typ, b[n:])
		if vn < 0 {
			return out
		}
		raw := b[:n+vn]
		switch {
		case num == 16 && typ == protowire.BytesType:
			// dropped
		case (num == 3 || num == 15) && typ == protowire.BytesType:
			sub, _ := protowire.ConsumeBytes(b[n:])
			var masked []byte
			for len(sub) > 0 {
				sn, st, tn := protowire.ConsumeTag(sub)
				sv := protowire.ConsumeFieldValue(sn, st, sub[tn:])
				if sn != 1 {
					masked = append(masked, sub[:tn+sv]...)
				}
				sub = sub[tn+sv:]
			}
			out = protowire.AppendTag(out, num, protowire.BytesType)
			out = protowire.AppendBytes(out, masked)
		default:
			out = append(out, raw...)
		}
		b = b[n+vn:]
	}
	return out
}

func TestDevinOracle(t *testing.T) {
	in := os.Getenv("DEVIN_ORACLE_IN")
	outPath := os.Getenv("DEVIN_ORACLE_OUT")
	if in == "" {
		t.Skip("no oracle input")
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(in)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var c oCases
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &c); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	// Wire requests.
	for i := range c.Wire {
		w := &c.Wire[i]
		helps.ResetDevinSessionTurnIndex(w.SessionID)
		n := w.Repeat
		if n < 1 {
			n = 1
		}
		for r := 0; r < n; r++ {
			tools := []helps.DevinTool{}
			for _, tl := range w.Tools {
				tools = append(tools, helps.DevinTool{Name: tl.Name, Description: tl.Description, Parameters: []byte(tl.Parameters)})
			}
			matcher := helps.BuildSensitiveWordMatcher(w.Words)
			b := helps.BuildDevinGetChatMessageRequest(w.SessionToken, w.DeviceSeed, w.ModelUID, w.System, toPrompts(w.Prompts), tools, w.Temperature, w.MaxTokens, w.SessionID, w.CascadeID, matcher)
			w.Hex = append(w.Hex, hex.EncodeToString(b))
		}
		helps.ResetDevinSessionTurnIndex(w.SessionID)
	}
	for i := range c.Sanitize {
		s := &c.Sanitize[i]
		s.Out = helps.SanitizeDevinSystemPrompt(s.Prompt, helps.BuildSensitiveWordMatcher(s.Words))
	}
	for i := range c.Trailers {
		tr := &c.Trailers[i]
		code, err := helps.ParseDevinTrailerError([]byte(tr.Payload))
		tr.Status = code
		if err != nil {
			tr.Err = err.Error()
		}
	}
	for i := range c.Models {
		m := &c.Models[i]
		m.Out = helps.ResolveDevinChatModelUID(m.Model, m.Level, m.Budget)
	}
	for _, mi := range registry.GetDevinModels() {
		base := strings.TrimPrefix(mi.ID, "devin/")
		for _, eff := range []string{"", "none", "minimal", "low", "medium", "high", "xhigh", "max", "auto", "fast"} {
			m := oModel{Model: "devin/" + base, Level: eff}
			m.Out = helps.ResolveDevinChatModelUID(m.Model, m.Level, 0)
			c.Models = append(c.Models, m)
		}
	}
	for i := range c.Parse {
		p := &c.Parse[i]
		sys, prompts, tools, temp, maxTokens, sess, casc, level, budget := parseInteractionsPayload([]byte(p.Payload), []byte(p.Original))
		po := parseOut{System: sys, Prompts: fromPrompts(prompts), Tools: []oTool{}, Temp: temp, MaxTokens: maxTokens, Session: sess, Cascade: casc, Level: level, Budget: budget}
		for _, tl := range tools {
			po.Tools = append(po.Tools, oTool{tl.Name, tl.Description, string(tl.Parameters)})
		}
		p.Out, _ = json.Marshal(po)
	}
	for i := range c.Sigs {
		s := &c.Sigs[i]
		b, ty := parseSignatureBytes(s.In)
		s.BytesB = base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(b)
		s.Type = ty
		s.Detect = detectSignatureType(s.In)
	}
	for i := range c.UUIDs {
		u := &c.UUIDs[i]
		if u.In == "" {
			continue
		}
		u.Out = normalizeDevinUUID(u.In)
		if _, err := uuid.Parse(u.In); err == nil {
			// keep
		}
	}

	for i := range c.E2E {
		e := &c.E2E[i]
		auth := &cliproxyauth.Auth{Attributes: map[string]string{"api_key": "tok", "device_seed": "seed"}}
		exec := &DevinExecutor{}
		req := cliproxyexecutor.Request{Model: e.Model, Payload: []byte(e.Payload)}
		opts := cliproxyexecutor.Options{SourceFormat: sdktranslator.Format(e.SourceFormat), OriginalRequest: []byte(e.Payload)}
		httpReq, _, _, err := exec.prepareDevinHTTPRequest(context.Background(), auth, req, opts)
		if err != nil {
			e.Err = err.Error()
			continue
		}
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(httpReq.Body)
		e.URL = httpReq.URL.String()
		e.Hex = hex.EncodeToString(maskProto(body[5:]))
	}

	formats := []sdktranslator.Format{sdktranslator.FormatInteractions, sdktranslator.FormatOpenAI, sdktranslator.FormatClaude, sdktranslator.FormatOpenAIResponse, sdktranslator.FormatGemini}
	for i := range c.Streams {
		s := &c.Streams[i]
		build := func() *bytes.Buffer {
			var buf bytes.Buffer
			for _, f := range s.Frames {
				if f.RawTail != "" {
					rb, _ := hex.DecodeString(f.RawTail)
					buf.Write(rb)
					continue
				}
				b, _ := hex.DecodeString(f.Hex)
				buf.Write(helps.WrapConnectEnvelopeWithFlag(byte(f.Flag), b))
			}
			return &buf
		}
		ij, _, errC := consumeDevinFramesToInteractions(build(), "devin/swe-2", "swe-2-high", []byte(s.Requests["interactions"]))
		s.Interactions = string(ij)
		if errC != nil {
			s.ConsumeErr = errC.Error()
			if se, ok := errC.(statusErr); ok {
				s.ConsumeCode = se.code
			}
		}
		for _, f := range formats {
			fo := oFormatOut{Format: f.String()}
			req := s.Requests[f.String()]
			e := &DevinExecutor{}
			out := make(chan cliproxyexecutor.StreamChunk, 8192)
			opts := cliproxyexecutor.Options{SourceFormat: f, OriginalRequest: []byte(req)}
			buf := build()
			go func() {
				defer close(out)
				e.streamDevinFrames(context.Background(), buf, cliproxyexecutor.Request{Model: "devin/swe-2", Payload: []byte(req)}, opts, "swe-2-high", f, nil, out)
			}()
			for ch := range out {
				if ch.Err != nil {
					msg := "ERR: " + ch.Err.Error()
					if se, ok := ch.Err.(statusErr); ok {
						msg += " code=" + string(rune('0'+se.code/100)) + string(rune('0'+(se.code/10)%10)) + string(rune('0'+se.code%10))
					}
					fo.Chunks = append(fo.Chunks, msg)
				} else {
					fo.Chunks = append(fo.Chunks, string(ch.Payload))
				}
			}
			if errC == nil {
				var param any
				nonStream := sdktranslator.TranslateNonStream(context.Background(), sdktranslator.FormatInteractions, f, "devin/swe-2", []byte(req), []byte(req), ij, &param)
				fo.NonStr = string(nonStream)
			}
			s.Formats = append(s.Formats, fo)
		}
	}

	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(c, "", " ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(outPath, b, 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
